description: This file contains a library of functions to mark up test script output for pretty-printing in GitHub workflows. It defines functions to handle test output, including starting test output, finalizing test cases, and managing output formatting with GitHub Actions annotations.

methods.name: start_test_output
methods.description: Initializes markup output for test logs, ensuring a log file is specified.

methods.name: finalize_test_case_output
methods.description: Handles the final output for a test case, emitting appropriate GitHub Actions annotations based on test result.
